title: Compact review habit journal
body:
Purpose:
- Capture a compact, repeatable review habit for fast refactors and small PRs (<= 30 files, <= 300 LOC).
- Reduce cognitive overhead for follow-ups and make post-merge cleanup explicit.
- Leave reproducible signals for later retros and automated triage.

Principles (short):
- 15 minute timebox per PR for initial pass; call for deeper review if > 2 risky items.
- Surface risks early (api invariants, db migrations, compatibility, security).
- Prefer small, actionable comments with test repro steps and suggested fixes.
- Triage follow-ups into: immediate block, follow-up ticket, TODO in code, or deferred (won't-fix).

Quick checklist (mental model):
- Context (30s): Title + description + linked ticket(s) make sense? Are screenshots/test data attached?
- Safety (2m): Any DB/schema changes? Feature flags? Migration strategy?
- API (2m): Public function/route changes — backwards compatible? Deprecated behavior handled?
- Tests (2m): Are there unit/integration tests? Do they exercise edge cases?
- Performance (2m): Any hot loops, N+1s, allocations, or sync blocking calls?
- Observability (1m): Metrics/logging/tracing added where failure modes exist?
- Formatting & docs (30s): Comments, README updates for public-facing changes?
- Small nit or quick fix? Push a small follow-up commit, mark in comment.

Micro heuristics and red flags (notes):
- Red flag: Silent changes to default config constants (timeouts, batch sizes) without a changelog.
- Red flag: New long-lived goroutine/thread created without lifecycle cleanup.
- Red flag: Using broad regex or text-replace across generated files.
- Heuristic: If a change touches >3 modules, escalate to a short walkthrough with the owner.
- Heuristic: If a PR has >3 "TODO" comments added, request a captured follow-up ticket.

Example comments / templates (fast):
- Quick positive ack: "LGTM modulo the two nits below — will merge after fixes or fast follow-up."
- Request test: "Can you add a unit test for the null/empty-case in handleRequest? simple table-driven case will do."
- Safety hold: "Hold on DB migration: need a rollback plan and a compatibility signal for older workers. Can we gate by feature flag?"
- Small fix request (inline): "Suggest: use 'strings.Builder' here to avoid repeated allocations; see snippet."

Follow-up capture structure (what I write in the review comment):
- "Follow-up created: INF-### — brief summary — assignee (optional) — priority: P1/P2 — ETA if known."
- If I add a TODO in code: add a short comment with the ticket id and date, e.g. "// TODO(INF-923) clear cache after rollout — RShah 2026-03-08"

Local repro quick commands (examples to paste):
- unit tests: make test ./pkg/handler -run TestHandle* -v
- run small load: scripts/loadtest --target http://localhost:8080/api/route --concurrency 8 --duration 15s
- snapshot: curl -sS http://localhost:8080/debug/kv | jq . > sample-kv-$(date +%s).json

Risk scoring (1-5 quick):
- 1: cosmetic / docs / tests only
- 2: small runtime change but confined to one module (low blast radius)
- 3: cross-module change or new infra dependency
- 4: introduces migration, compatibility concerns, or new runtime thread
- 5: security-sensitive, data loss, or customer-visible correctness regression

When to ask for a synchronous pairing walkthrough:
- Any score >=4.
- Complex migration/flaky repro that can't be captured in a short test.
- Major API contract change that affects multiple teams.

Mini-post-merge routine (what I do within 24–72h):
- Check the merged PR for reopened issues or failed smoke tests.
- Add a short note to the PR: "post-merge quick check completed: smoke OK / failed on X".
- If I left follow-ups, ensure they appear on the weekly triage board; ping assignees.

Personal TODOs (for this habit):
- Automate a local script that generates the risk-score template for new PRs (INF-1015).
- Add a label shortcut in GH for "follow-up: infra" and "follow-up: docs".
- Try a week of only 15-min boxed initial reviews and measure merge cycle delta.

Open questions / experiments to try:
- Can we add a PR template checkbox that auto-populates a minimal risk score?
- Experiment: auto-detect large diffs touching > 5 packages and require a two-reviewer rule.
- Can CI run a fast local perf check for any changes touching the hotpath? (cheap sample input)

Short log (recent sessions):
- 2026-03-01: Reviewed PR #4821 — quick pass, flagged migration strategy. Created INF-923 for cleanup.
- 2026-03-04: Follow-up INF-923 assigned to Nadia — added TODO with ticket id in code.
- 2026-03-07: Noticed one flaky test post-merge; opened INF-981 to triage flaky suite.

Notes to self (style):
- Keep comments actionable and minimal — include code pointers and reproduction steps.
- When in doubt, add an automated follow-up ticket rather than burying TODOs in comments.
- Keep the habit: 15 minutes, one clear decision (merge/hold/follow-up).

----
End of scratch.
